description: §40.2 / §52.13 (S443 review F3) — an `auth="required"` program whose `loginRedirect=` is its own route (`/case`, the route of case.scrml) redirects an anonymous request to itself forever; W-AUTH-REDIRECT-LOOP fires.
rationale: §40.2 (S443): 'When a gated route's redirect target is that route itself … an anonymous request redirects in a loop; the compiler SHALL emit `W-AUTH-REDIRECT-LOOP` for that route.'
